newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada raw materials prices rise 1.5 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Canada raw materials prices rise 1.5 pct in Sept.

text.p: Statistics Canada on Tuesday issued the following economic indicators for September, base 1986=100.
INDEX Month pct Yr pct Sept index

The raw materials price index reflects the prices paid by manufacturers for key raw materials. Unlike the industrial product price index, the raw materials price index includes goods that are not produced in Canada.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that the overall index would be rise 1.7 percent from August.
(For more information, contact Statistics Canada's Client Services Unit, Prices Division at (613) 951-3350.)
